title: 第十一章 女海王狂飙演技第十二章 各自肚肠
slug: 诸天影视从四合院开始
content_zh:
贾张氏让自己的儿媳秦淮茹夹枪带棒的一通怼，给怼的不言语了。
秦淮茹将晚饭端了上来，只见三个小崽子抱着窝窝头，喝着棒子面儿粥的频率，跟平时大不相同。
这也难怪，谁的肚子里沾了一下子的荤腥，一时之间对这种粗茶淡饭也不会再感兴趣的。
平时遇到这种事情，秦淮茹是乐不得呢，半大小子，吃死老子，他们仨的肚皮就跟个无底洞似的，不一会儿就能干下去个窝窝头，但是今天，秦淮茹却没有任何开心的心情，因为这是以二十块钱作为代价换来的。
虽说今天晚上这笔钱是傻柱掏的，可是在秦淮茹的心里，傻柱的一切，只要是自己张张嘴，那都是手到擒来，秦淮茹早就把傻柱兜里的钱当成是自己的了，所以肉疼是在所难免的了，要不然今晚她也不会这样的爆发。
这特娘的都是自己的银子啊，都让这仨小崽子给败坏光了，自己最起码三个月之内没法跟傻柱张口，一是因为他一时间手头缓不过来，二是因为他妹妹何雨水那个赔钱货年底要出嫁了。
吃完饭后，秦淮茹就着灯光正在给三个小崽子补衣裳，今天保卫科抓这三个小崽子的时候，他们三个剧烈挣扎，棉袄都撕裂了，棉花都漏了出来，打归打，骂归骂，那终究是自己的种，总不能让他们仨穿的破衣烂衫的出门，那丢的是她这个当娘的脸。
秦淮茹正在缝衣服的时候，她家窗外传来了一个声音：
“秦淮茹在家吗？秦淮茹在家吗？”
秦淮茹一听声音就知道是一大爷易中海，作为一个女海王，她从没放过任何一个潜力股，一大爷易中海作为厂里的八级钳工，在当时那个年代，绝对站在行业鄙视链的塔尖儿，要知道他一个月的工资就是一百多块钱，那个年月的一百多块，换算到现在最起码也得七八千，这是妥妥的人生赢家。
秦淮茹没少跟易中海这里蹭吃蹭喝，家里过不下去的光景，全都靠着易中海偷着帮衬。
秦淮茹举目朝着窗户外边看去，只见一大爷手里拎着半拉面口袋，秦淮茹顿时喜上眉梢，赶忙迎了出去。
易中海站在门口，见秦淮茹迎了出来，易中海脸上不自觉的露出了笑模样，秦淮茹贪图一口吃的，在他这儿占便宜，他作为一个老鬼，心里怎么会没有数儿呢，没办法，谁让自己贪恋这俏寡妇身上的味道呢。
秦淮茹临出门之前，特意用手在眼眶上使劲儿的搓揉，下晚儿的时候，在轧钢厂厂长办公室里，哭的有些肿胀的眼泡，瞬间变得通红，只见她来到了一大爷的面前，声音有些微发颤的说道：
“一大爷，你来了。”
一大爷都懵了，天太黑，刚才离远了还没看清楚，这离近了，接着月光一打量，俏寡妇的眼泡都肿了起来，一大爷急忙开口问道：
“淮如，你这是咋了？”
贾张氏在她的厢房听到了秦淮茹推门出来的动静，对着上了霜的玻璃哈了口哈气，然后用棉袄袖子擦出了一块光亮，举目朝着外面看去，只见一大爷从兜里掏出了一块手帕，正在帮秦淮茹擦眼泪，贾张氏脸上闪过了一丝不屑的表情，小声地唾道：
“he—tui，骚狐狸，也不嫌丢人，就是个浪催的货！”
这个老家伙才不会考虑自己吃的那口东西是咋来的。

一大爷用手帕将秦淮茹眼前的泪水轻轻的拭去，看着面前的俏寡妇哭的梨花带雨的模样，一大爷是好不心疼，连忙开口问道：
“淮如你这是咋了？是谁欺负你了吗？有啥委屈你跟一大爷说，一大爷帮你做主！”
不得不说，秦淮茹作为一个女海王，对于演技这一块儿，拿捏的这是死死的，只见她抽泣着，用她断断续续的声音，将今天在厂长办公室里发生的一幕，跟一大爷易中海添油加醋的描述了一遍，易中海的脸色是愈加的难看。
平时这个院子里有个什么大事小情，都是以他为首的三个大爷做主，他也已经习惯了自己高高在上发着号施令的模样，今天听秦淮茹这么一说，一大爷瞬间感觉许大茂这个孙子有脱离自己掌控的苗头。
是你许大茂飘了，还是欺负我易中海拎不动刀了？这件事情非得好好的说道说道！
二大爷刘海中晚上吃完饭看报纸的时候，多喝了几和茶水，半夜正起来上厕所，在打了一个哆嗦之后，脸上一脸舒服的表情，刚系好裤子，就哭到了一个女人抽抽噎噎的声音吓得刘海中又打了一个哆嗦，还寻思自己大半夜的遇见女鬼了呢，他小心翼翼的循声张望，这才发现一大爷易中海和秦淮茹站在院当腰说话。
看到一大爷给秦淮茹擦眼泪，二人之间的行为愈加亲昵，刘海中的脸上露出了鄙视的神色。
但是有免费的八卦，那是不看白不看，刘海中找了根柱子，躲在了后面，倾听着二人的谈话。
这也幸亏是天黑，要不然画面还真的有些玄幻，因为那根柱子随着刘海中藏在后面，明显的粗了一截，柱子本身有些苗条，遮挡不住刘海中那肥硕的身材啊！
这时只听秦淮茹有些抽搐的开口说道：
“赔给许大茂三十块钱之后，我欠了傻柱三十块钱的饥荒不说，临走的时候，李副厂长还说我家三小崽子违反了安全防火条例，把我这个月的奖金都给扣了，这可叫我怎么活啊？”
易中海看着秦淮茹可怜巴巴的模样，心里别提多难受了，只见他发挥出了自己的财大气粗，从挎兜里掏出了四十块钱，抓过了秦淮茹的小手，将钱塞到秦淮茹的手中，开口说道：
“淮如啊，你放心，一大爷绝对会给你讨还一个公道，许大茂这种行为属于无组织无纪律，明天我就找刘海中和阎埠贵，我们要针对这件事情开个会，严肃认真的讨论他的错误。”
秦淮茹看到易中海往自己手心里塞钱，本来还挺开心的，可是过了一会儿，秦淮茹脸上的表情却有些凝固，嘴角轻微的抽搐，一大爷，你给我钱我欢迎，可是你倒是把抓着我的手松开啊！

content_en:
Mrs. Jia Zhang asked her daughter-in-law Qin Huairu to fight with a gun and a stick, and she was speechless.
Qin Huairu brought the dinner, and saw the three little boys hugging Wowotou and drinking stick noodle porridge with a frequency that was very different from usual.
It's no wonder that anyone who has a bit of meat in their stomach will no longer be interested in such a simple meal.
Normally, Qin Huairu would not be happy when encountering this kind of thing. The three of them would be like a bottomless pit if they were half-grown and would eat me to death. They would be able to make a living in a short time. But today, Qin Huairu was not in any happy mood, because this was obtained at the cost of twenty yuan.
Although the money tonight was paid by Sha Zhu, in Qin Huairu's heart, everything about Sha Zhu was within reach as long as she opened her mouth. Qin Huairu had already regarded the money in Sha Zhu's pocket as her own, so the pain was unavoidable, otherwise she would not have exploded like this tonight.
All this girl's money is her own, and she has ruined all of it with these three brats. She won't be able to talk to Silly Zhu for at least three months, firstly because he can't get enough money for a while, and secondly because his sister He Yuyu, the loser, is getting married at the end of the year.
After finishing the meal, Qin Huairu was mending the clothes of the three cubs under the light. When the security department arrested the three cubs today, the three of them struggled violently. The cotton-padded jackets were torn and the cotton leaked out. They were beaten and beaten and scolded. After all, it was their own kind. She could not let the three of them go out in rags. It would be a disgrace to her, a mother-in-law.
When Qin Huairu was sewing clothes, a voice came from outside her window:
"Is Qin Huairu at home? Is Qin Huairu at home?"
As soon as Qin Huairu heard the voice, she knew it was the First Master Yi Zhonghai. As a female sea king, she never let go of any potential stock. The First Master Yi Zhonghai, as an eighth-level fitter in the factory, was definitely at the top of the industry's despised chain at that time. You must know that his monthly salary was more than 100 yuan. The more than 100 yuan at that time would be at least 7,000 to 8,000 yuan now. This is a sure winner in life.
Qin Huairu spent a lot of time eating and drinking with Yi Zhonghai. When the family couldn't survive, she relied on Yi Zhonghai to help her secretly.
Qin Huairu raised her eyes and looked outside the window, and saw the uncle holding half a bag of ramen noodles in his hand. Qin Huairu was immediately happy and hurriedly went out to greet him.
Yi Zhonghai stood at the door and saw Qin Huairu coming out. A smile appeared on Yi Zhonghai's face unconsciously. Qin Huairu was greedy for a bite to eat and took advantage of him. As an old ghost, how could he not know what to do? He had no choice but to let himself be greedy for the smell of this pretty widow.
Before Qin Huairu went out, she rubbed her eyes hard with her hands. In the evening, in the office of the director of the steel rolling mill, her eyeballs were swollen from crying and instantly turned red. She came to the uncle and said in a slightly trembling voice:
"Master, you are here."
The old man was confused. It was too dark. He was far away just now and couldn't see clearly. Now he was closer. Then when he looked at it in the moonlight, the pretty widow's eyeballs were swollen. The old man hurriedly asked:
"Huai Ru, what's wrong with you?"
Jia Zhang heard the movement of Qin Huairu opening the door in her wing. She breathed against the frosted glass, then wiped out a piece of light with the sleeve of her cotton-padded jacket. Looking outside, she saw the uncle took out a handkerchief from his pocket and was wiping Qin Huairu's tears. A look of disdain flashed across Jia Zhang's face, and she whispered:
"He-tui, you are a coquettish fox, you are not ashamed of yourself, you are just a waste of money!"
This old guy doesn't think about where the food he ate came from.
The uncle gently wiped away the tears from Qin Huairu's eyes with a handkerchief and looked at the pretty girl in front of him.The widow was crying like a pear blossom with rain in her eyes. The uncle felt very sorry for her and asked quickly:
"Huairu, what's wrong with you? Who bullied you? If you have any grievances, tell me, and I will help you make the decision!"
It has to be said that Qin Huairu, as a female Neptune, is very good at acting. She was sobbing and using her intermittent voice, she described the scene that happened in the factory director's office today to the uncle Yi Zhonghai in an embellished manner. Yi Zhonghai's face became even more ugly.
Usually, the three uncles headed by him make the final decision on any big or small matter in this yard. He has also become accustomed to the way he is giving orders from a high position. After hearing what Qin Huairu said today, the first uncle instantly felt that Xu Damao, his grandson, was on the verge of getting out of his control.
Is it you, Xu Damao, who has lost his temper, or is it that Yi Zhonghai, who bullied me, can no longer bear the knife? This matter must be properly discussed!
The second uncle, Liu Haizhong, drank a few more cups of tea while reading the newspaper after dinner. He got up in the middle of the night to go to the toilet. After shivering, he had a comfortable expression on his face. As soon as he tied his pants, he cried like a woman. The sound of sobbing frightened his bangs and made him shiver again. He was also thinking that he had met a female ghost in the middle of the night. He carefully followed the sound and found that the elders Yi Zhonghai and Qin Huairu were standing in the courtyard talking.
Seeing the first uncle wiping Qin Huairu's tears, the behavior between the two became more and more intimate, and a look of contempt appeared on Liu Haizhong's face.
But there is free gossip, and it is nothing if you don't see it. He found a pillar in his bangs, hid behind it, and listened to the conversation between the two.
Fortunately, it was dark, otherwise the picture would be a bit fantasy, because the pillar was hidden behind the bangs, and it was obviously thicker. The pillar itself was a bit slender, and it couldn't cover the fat figure of the bangs!
At this time, Qin Huairu said with some twitching:
"After paying Xu Damao 30 yuan, I owed Sha Zhu 30 yuan, not to mention the famine. Before I left, Deputy Factory Director Li said that my three little boys violated safety and fire prevention regulations and deducted all my bonus for this month. How can I survive?"
Yi Zhonghai looked at Qin Huairu's pitiful appearance, not to mention how uncomfortable he felt. He showed his wealth and took out forty yuan from his shoulder pocket, grabbed Qin Huairu's little hand, put the money into Qin Huairu's hand, and said:
"Huai Ru, don't worry, I will definitely seek justice for you. Xu Damao's behavior is unorganized and undisciplined. Tomorrow I will find Liu Haizhong and Yan Bugui. We will hold a meeting on this matter and discuss his mistakes seriously."
Qin Huairu was quite happy when she saw Yi Zhonghai stuffing money into her hand. However, after a while, the expression on Qin Huairu's face became a little frozen, and the corners of her mouth twitched slightly. "Master, I welcome you to give me money, but you should let go of my hand!"
